description: Notification sent to a user when a room admin has muted (or unmuted) them in a chat room.
subject: You've been muted in chat room "$room_name"
body:
Hello $user_name,

This is to let you know that a room admin has changed your messaging permissions in the chat room "$room_name".

Details:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Room:       $room_name
Action:     Muted
By:         $actor_name
Date:       $action_date
Muted until: $muted_until
Reason:     $reason
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

What this means:
• You can still read messages in this room, but you can't send new ones until the mute expires or an admin lifts it.
• Other rooms you're a member of are unaffected.
• If you believe this was a mistake, please contact the room admin shown above.

Kind regards,
University Communications

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
This is an automated notification. Please do not reply to this email.
